# CI and repository automation

- `.github/workflows/pages.yml` runs on push to `main`, every `pull_request` and `workflow_dispatch`, with concurrency `pages-${{ github.ref }}` (cancel in progress). Job `verify`: checkout, setup-node from `.nvmrc`, `npm ci --ignore-scripts`, gitleaks over full history and over `dist/`, `npm run check`, `npm audit --audit-level=high`, `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium`, `npm run test:e2e`, then (main only) configure-pages and upload `dist`. Job `deploy` (main only) publishes to the `github-pages` environment.
- `verify` is the required status check (strict, linear history). Never rename the job or move its gates behind conditions that skip on PRs.
- Pin every action by full 40-character commit SHA with a `# vX.Y.Z` comment; update both together and prefer the SHA the extension repo already pins (site-deps).
- Permissions: workflow default `contents: read`; `verify` read-only (`contents: read`, `pages: read`); only `deploy` gets `pages: write` and `id-token: write`. Never add write scopes elsewhere, never use `pull_request_target`, never echo secrets — the site needs none (Pages uses OIDC).
- Checkout keeps `persist-credentials: false`; `fetch-depth: 0` is required for the history scan.
- gitleaks: version and SHA-256 are pinned together; `.gitleaks.toml` adds the `AQ.` provider-key rule. Never add allowlists or `--no-git`/path exclusions to pass a finding.
- Keep `timeout-minutes` on every job. Deploy steps stay gated on `github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'` and `github.event_name != 'pull_request'`.
- `copilot-setup-steps.yml`: the single job must stay named `copilot-setup-steps`; only setup steps (checkout, setup-node, `npm ci --ignore-scripts`, Playwright Chromium). Keep its action pins equal to `pages.yml`.
- `dependabot.yml`: npm and github-actions, weekly, `open-pull-requests-limit: 3`, target `main`.
- Agents never change repository settings, branch protection, the `github-pages` environment, or Actions secrets/variables; those are the user's.
- Verify: `npx prettier --check .github`; push the branch and watch `gh pr checks --watch`; for workflow edits read the run log (`gh run view <id> --log`) to confirm each step ran.
